desc.text:
<color=#ffd780>Elemental Skill</color>
<color=#ffffffa6>Deals 1</color> <color=#80ffd7>Anemo DMG</color> <color=#ffffffa6>, enters</color> <color=#ffffff>Nightsoul's Blessing</color> <color=#ffffffa6>, gains 2</color> <color=#ffffff>Nightsoul points</color> <color=#ffffffa6>, and applies</color> <color=#ffffff>Cacucu</color> <color=#ffffffa6>to self. (This skill cannot be used after the character enters</color> <color=#ffffff>Nightsoul's Blessing</color> <color=#ffffffa6>.)</color>
<color=#ffffffa6>(Characters with</color> <color=#ffffff>Cacucu</color> <color=#ffffffa6>attached can use the Technique:</color> <color=#ffffff>Supporting Fire</color> <color=#ffffffa6>)</color>
<color=#ece5d8>Nightsoul's Blessing</color>
<color=#ffd780>Status</color>
<color=#ffffffa6>The character to which this is attached accumulates</color> <color=#ffffff>Nightsoul points</color> <color=#ffffffa6>. (Max 2 points)</color>
<color=#ffffffa6>When the character has 0 Nightsoul points, they exit</color> <color=#ffffff>Nightsoul's Blessing</color> <color=#ffffffa6>.</color>

<color=#ffd780>Equipment Card</color>
<color=#ffffff>Technique</color> <color=#ffffffa6>: Supporting Fire.</color>
<color=#ffffffa6>When the character to which this is attached has 0</color> <color=#ffffff>Nightsoul points</color> <color=#ffffffa6>, discard this card. When this card is discarded, the attached character's</color> <color=#ffffff>Nightsoul's Blessing</color> <color=#ffffffa6>ends.</color>
<color=#ece5d8>Nightsoul's Blessing</color>
<color=#ffd780>Status</color>
<color=#ffffffa6>The character to which this is attached accumulates</color> <color=#ffffff>Nightsoul points</color> <color=#ffffffa6>. (Max 2 points)</color>
<color=#ffffffa6>When the character has 0 Nightsoul points, they exit</color> <color=#ffffff>Nightsoul's Blessing</color> <color=#ffffffa6>.</color>

<color=#ffd780>Technique</color>
<color=#ffffffa6>Consumes 1</color> <color=#ffffff>Nightsoul point</color> <color=#ffffffa6>, deals 1</color> <color=#80ffd7>Anemo DMG</color> <color=#ffffffa6>to the previous opposing character, and heals the character on your team who has taken the most DMG for 2 HP.</color>
<color=#ece5d8>Nightsoul's Blessing</color>
<color=#ffd780>Status</color>
<color=#ffffffa6>The character to which this is attached accumulates</color> <color=#ffffff>Nightsoul points</color> <color=#ffffffa6>. (Max 2 points)</color>
<color=#ffffffa6>When the character has 0 Nightsoul points, they exit</color> <color=#ffffff>Nightsoul's Blessing</color> <color=#ffffffa6>.</color>

<color=#ffd780>Elemental Burst</color>
<color=#ffffffa6>Deals 2</color> <color=#80ffd7>Anemo DMG</color> <color=#ffffffa6>, heals the character on your team who has taken the most DMG for 2 HP. If this Skill triggers</color> <color=#80ffd7>Anemo-Related Reactions</color> <color=#ffffffa6>, attach a</color> <color=#ffffff>Sedation Mark</color> <color=#ffffffa6>of the corresponding element to the opponent's active character.</color>

Reacts with Elements if they are already applied:
[ <color=#80ffd7>Anemo</color> + <color=#99ffff>Cryo</color> ] <color=#ffffff>Cryo Swirl</color> : Deals 1 Cryo DMG to all opposing chracters except the target
[ <color=#80ffd7>Anemo</color> + <color=#80c0ff>Hydro</color> ] <color=#ffffff>Hydro Swirl:</color> Deals 1 Hydro DMG to all opposing characters except the target
[ <color=#80ffd7>Anemo</color> + <color=#ff9999>Pyro</color> ] <color=#ffffff>Pyro Swirl</color> : Deals 1 Pyro DMG to all opposing characters except the target
[ <color=#80ffd7>Anemo</color> + <color=#ffacff>Electro</color> ] <color=#ffffff>Electro Swirl</color> : Deals 1 Electro DMG to all opposing characters except the target

<color=#ece5d8>Technique</color>
When the active character is equipped with a Technique card, they can use the corresponding Technique.
Using a Technique counts as a Combat Action. If the character is unable to use Skills due to conditions like Frozen, Petrification, or Stun, they are also unable to use the Technique.
Using a Technique is not considered as using a Skill. Therefore, it cannot trigger effects such as "After using a skill" or "After the character triggers an Elemental Reaction." Damage dealt by using a Technique is not considered Damage dealt by the character.
<color=#80ffd7>Anemo-Related Reactions</color>
[ <color=#80ffd7>Anemo</color> + <color=#99ffff>Cryo</color> ] <color=#ffffff>Cryo Swirl</color> : Deals 1 Cryo DMG to all opposing chracters except the target
[ <color=#80ffd7>Anemo</color> + <color=#80c0ff>Hydro</color> ] <color=#ffffff>Hydro Swirl:</color> Deals 1 Hydro DMG to all opposing characters except the target
[ <color=#80ffd7>Anemo</color> + <color=#ff9999>Pyro</color> ] <color=#ffffff>Pyro Swirl</color> : Deals 1 Pyro DMG to all opposing characters except the target
[ <color=#80ffd7>Anemo</color> + <color=#ffacff>Electro</color> ] <color=#ffffff>Electro Swirl</color> : Deals 1 Electro DMG to all opposing characters except the target
<color=#ece5d8>Sedation Mark</color>
<color=#ffffff>Before the side of the field that this card is on chooses their action:</color> <color=#ffffffa6>Deal 2 DMG of the corresponding element to the attached character.</color>
<color=#ffffffa6>Usage(s): 1.</color>

customize.desc: Currency verified and used by the Genius Invokation TCG Society. Can be used to purchase various items related to Genius Invokation TCG. It is said that these coins were initially named as such in the hopes that they would bring those carrying them luck. However, perhaps it is those who are sufficiently lucky who are able to possess them...
